title: GPG detached signatures
description: The classic .asc/.sig sidecar: gpg --detach-sign, verified against the author’s public key. It signs release tarballs; verify with gpg --verify file.sig file. Standard: RFC 4880.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Sigstore cosign
description: Keyless signing binding artifacts to OIDC identity with signatures logged in Rekor. It signs container images; verify with cosign verify --certificate-identity .... Standard: Sigstore spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Authenticode
description: Windows’ PE signing; SmartScreen and driver policies gate on valid signatures. It signs EXE/DLL/sys drivers; verify with signtool verify /pa file.exe. Standard: Microsoft Authenticode.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Apple notarization
description: Apple staples a notarization ticket to signed macOS software for Gatekeeper approval. It signs macOS apps; verify with spctl -a -vv app.app. Standard: Apple TN2206.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: minisign
description: A dead-simple Ed25519 signing tool by Frank Denis with tiny trusted-comment signatures. It signs any file; verify with minisign -V -p key.pub -m file. Standard: Ed25519 (RFC 8032).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: OpenBSD signify
description: signify signs base releases with short base64 keys designed for easy human verification. It signs OS releases; verify with signify -V -p key.pub -m file. Standard: Ed25519.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: RPM package signing
description: RPMs embed GPG signatures; rpm -K checks the package against imported keys. It signs RPM packages; verify with rpm -K pkg.rpm. Standard: RPM spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Debian debsig-verify
description: debsig-verify checks .deb signatures against per-origin policies for archive trust. It signs Debian packages; verify with debsig-verify policy.pol pkg.deb. Standard: Debian policy.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Android APK signing
description: APK Signature Scheme v2 signs the whole APK; v4 enables fs-verity incremental verification. It signs Android APKs; verify with apksigner verify app.apk. Standard: Android docs.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: UEFI Secure Boot
description: Firmware verifies bootloader signatures against keys in the signature database (db). It signs bootloaders/shims; verify with firmware db/dbx check. Standard: UEFI spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: dm-verity
description: The kernel verifies block-device reads against a Merkle tree — Android’s verified boot core. It signs system partitions; verify with kernel Merkle verification. Standard: Linux kernel docs.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: TUF
description: The Update Framework defines roles (root, targets, snapshot, timestamp) so key compromise is contained. It signs update repositories; verify with tuf client workflow. Standard: TUF spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: in-toto attestations
description: in-toto records each supply-chain step’s signed evidence so verifiers check the whole pipeline. It signs build steps; verify with in-toto-verify. Standard: in-toto spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: SLSA provenance
description: SLSA levels rate build integrity; provenance attestations describe exactly how artifacts were built. It signs build provenance; verify with slsa-verifier. Standard: SLSA spec.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: SSH commit signing
description: git commit -S with SSH keys (not just GPG) ties commits to the developer’s SSH identity. It signs git commits/tags; verify with git log --show-signature. Standard: OpenSSH PROTOCOL.sshsig.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
